conversation_export.topic: Becoming an art manager and building a growth strategy for an artist client

content.definition: An art manager handles the business and career side of an artist's practice, so the artist can focus on making work.
responsibilities: Relationship management with galleries, venues, buyers
key_skills: Eye for art and market fit

steps: Onboard the artist (collect portfolio, background, pricing, goals)
Build the artist profile and pitch materials (bio, statement, images, price list)
Identify and shortlist venues/buyers matched to style and price point
Pitch and negotiate terms, get written agreements
Manage logistics for the show/placement (framing, transport, inventory)
Report back and iterate after each show/placement

portfolio_inventory: High-quality images of all available work
Title, medium, dimensions, year, edition info per piece
Which pieces are for sale vs. not for sale
pricing: Current/desired price per piece or formula
goals_and_boundaries: Primary goal: sales income, exposure, following, gallery representation

goals: Get his art into the fashion industry (t-shirt/shirt collaborations with brands)
sections.context_note: Client has a fine arts degree specializing in typography, from a well-renowned art college. Currently has no public recognition.

order: Build visual proof-of-work first (photograph work, start process reels)
Create the artist magazine/zine early as a credibility tool
Apply to residencies in parallel (long lead times, don't require prior fame)
Pitch small/niche fashion & apparel brands directly, leading with typography specialization
Use residency outcomes and brand collabs to unlock exhibitions (group shows first)
Let recognition compound from documented, stacked proof points

sections.source: Based on 8 reference images shared by the user showing artworks the client admires
recurring_themes: Containment and framing (glass boxes, mirrored cubes, acrylic vitrines)
The body breaking through the 2D plane (hands emerging from paintings/plaster)
Hyperrealism used for unease rather than beauty
Scale distortion (giant objects in landscapes, tiny figures against massive structures)
Restrained palette with a single loud accent color
Senses and perception as subject matter (eyes, ears, mouths)
Fashion-editorial style staging in some reference pieces
sections.open_question_raised: Whether this reference style matches the client's current actual output, or is aspirational relative to his present typography-based work

steps: Define his signature intersection: type + surrealism + containment (3-5 original signature pieces)
Film process reels around these specific signature pieces (not generic painting content)
Build the artist magazine as a visual artifact reflecting his own aesthetic (editorial/campaign style)
Target fashion brands whose past campaigns already share this visual language (conceptual/surreal, not just product collabs)
Apply to residencies matched to his materials (glass, plaster, mixed media, experimental typography) rather than generalist residencies
Pitch themed group exhibitions (surrealism, identity, perception, materiality) rather than open-call generalist shows
Package the full story for press once 2-3 proof points exist (signature series + residency or brand collab or exhibition)

sections.requirement: Client needs a residency with stipend/grant
user_provided_list: Tokyo Arts and Space (TOKAS) International Creator Residency
Kyoto Art Center Artist in Residence Program
L-AIR Himeji Artist in Residence & Support Program
Banff Centre Early Career Banff Artist in Residence

findings.name: Gasworks
findings.eligibility: Early-career visual artists based in India (current India-specific open call)

funding.flights: Return economy flights from India covered

findings.fit_notes: Strong fit — open to any visual art discipline, suits sculpture/mixed-media/containment work well.

findings.name: Delfina Foundation
findings.eligibility: Current call restricted to Latin American, Caribbean, and USA-based diaspora artists; India not currently eligible
findings.fit_notes: Historical precedent for India-specific residency via Charles Wallace India Trust / Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation partnership — monitor for future India-focused call.

findings.name: EMAP (European Media Art Platform)
findings.eligibility: Must apply as duo/collective or collaborative project; primarily EU residents/taxpayers or eligible non-EU countries

funding.travel: Covered by host per EU ceilings

findings.fit_notes: Scoped to digital, media, robotic, AI, and bio art — not a natural fit for sculptural/material-based practice unless a digital angle is developed. Duo/collective requirement is also a barrier.

findings.name: UNIDEE / Fondazione Pistoletto Cittadellarte
findings.eligibility: Current 'Ecosystems as Living Communities' call: one Italian artist + one international artist residing in Europe

funding.accommodation: Single room with shared facilities provided

findings.fit_notes: Thematically focused on socially engaged/ecological practice — a stretch from containment/surrealism direction. Current call requires EU residency.

findings.name: Palazzo Monti
findings.eligibility: Open to international artists, anonymous selection
findings.fit_notes: Strong materials/aesthetic fit (ceramic, iron, bronze, marble, wood) but does not meet the stipend/grant requirement.

conversation_export.export_note: This is a structured summary of the conversation's content, not a verbatim transcript. Residency data was current as of research date; funding/eligibility details should be re-verified before application given how frequently these change.
